snippet.title: Spotsanity - DEMO TRAILER | SAGExpo '26
snippet.description:
After months upon months of development, I'm proud to finally showcase a taste of what Spotsanity has to offer to the public!

SAGExpo: https://www.sagexpo.org/games
Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/spotsanity/1001396

"What's Spotsanity?"
Spotsanity is an upcoming 2D fast-paced, action-platformer about a hunter against a wide amount of adversaries.

You play as Spottie! After hearing rumors of secret treasure hidden afar, you've set of to scavenge it and obtain riches beyond anyone's comprehension.

But it wont be easy...

You're not the only one aware of this treasure. Many foes and adversaries are also on the hunt for this treasure, and they won't just let you have it. They'll attempt to stop you from getting that treasure, but you won't go out without a fight!


You'll fight off all foes and fiends, race against them, and push through obstacles to reach the treasure before anyone else can in this massive brawl.

If anyone's getting that treasure, it's going to be you.

It's You Vs. The World...

Thumbnail Art by KappaNerd!
